verdict: Plain nasi lemak is better for weight loss. It has slightly more calories, but more protein and keeps you fuller, so you're less likely to eat more.
why: Roti canai kosong is lower in calories: about 300 kcal versus 400 kcal for a packet of plain nasi lemak.
Nasi lemak has egg and ikan bilis, so protein is about 12 g versus 7 g for roti canai. Protein helps you stay full longer.
It's very easy to order a second roti canai. Two pieces is already about 600 kcal, more than a packet of nasi lemak.
Fat isn't very different either: about 17 g for nasi lemak, 12 g for one roti canai.
when_a: Nasi lemak suits you when you want a breakfast that lasts until lunch, for example on a busy workday.
when_b: Roti canai kosong is okay when one piece is truly enough for you, and you drink teh o kosong (plain tea, no sugar) or kurang manis (less sweet).
tip: If you choose roti canai, ask for dhal gravy and add a half-boiled egg. Protein goes up, and you won't feel like ordering a second piece.

faq.q: Can I eat nasi lemak every morning while trying to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, if your total daily calories are still under control. Pick the plain one, just enough sambal, and balance your lunch with more vegetables and protein dishes.

faq.q: Is curry gravy or dhal gravy better with roti canai?
faq.a: Dhal gravy is usually less oily and has a bit of protein from the lentils. But any gravy is okay, as long as you don't pour on too much.
